<h1 class="wp-block-heading">Comedy Ghostwriting</h1>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-lede"} -->
<p class="tm-lede">I write killer jokes for podcasts and YouTube channels looking to increase engagement through humor. Tell me what your episode or video covers, and you’ll get a page of custom jokes and ad throws to pepper into your script in the way that’s most organic to your show.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Lines from real one-sheets</h2>

<div class="wp-block-group tm-joke"><!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-joke-text"} -->
<p class="tm-joke-text">In this movie, a man risks everything to save a rock. In Kevin Hart movies, a man risks everything to save The Rock.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-joke-src"} -->
<p class="tm-joke-src">Project Hail Mary</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:group -->

<p class="tm-joke-text">The severance procedure is messed up. The only time you shouldn’t remember what happened at work is the day after the office Christmas party.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-joke-src"} -->
<p class="tm-joke-src">Severance</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:group -->

<!-- wp:group {"className":"tm-joke"} -->

<p class="tm-joke-text">The salaries for the movie’s stars leaked online. The original was based on a book. The sequel is based on a checkbook.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-joke-src"} -->
<p class="tm-joke-src">The Devil Wears Prada 2</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>

<!-- wp:group {"className":"tm-joke"} -->

<p class="tm-joke-text">The show is called The White Lotus and the creator is Mike White. I guess he felt “The Mike Lotus” was too on-the-nose.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-joke-src"} -->
<p class="tm-joke-src">The White Lotus</p>

<!-- wp:group {"className":"tm-joke"} -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-joke-src"} -->
<p class="tm-joke-src">Weapons</p>

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-joke-src"} -->
<p class="tm-joke-src">Severance</p>

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-joke-src"} -->

<p class="tm-joke-src">Severance</p>

<p class="tm-joke-src">Weapons</p>

<!-- wp:group {"className":"tm-panel tm-narrow"} -->
<div class="wp-block-group tm-panel tm-narrow"><!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-eyebrow"} -->
<p class="tm-eyebrow">Why humor matters</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Funny keeps people watching and listening</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-lede"} -->
<p class="tm-lede">A laugh early in an episode or video gives your audience a reason to stay, and a reason to come back next week. Your show already has the opinions and the expertise. A one-sheet adds the punchlines.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></div>
<!-- /wp:group -->

<!-- wp:group -->
<div class="wp-block-group"><!-- wp:group {"className":"tm-section-head"} -->
<div class="wp-block-group tm-section-head"><!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-eyebrow"} -->
<p class="tm-eyebrow">How it works</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Three steps</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading --></div>
<!-- /wp:group -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true,"className":"tm-steps"} -->
<ol class="wp-block-list tm-steps"><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Choose a package and check out through PayPal.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>At checkout, tell me what your episode or video covers, or any other topic you want jokes about. Retainer clients list each month’s topics when they pay that month’s invoice.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Get your one-sheet: within 5 days for a single sheet, within 3 days on a retainer.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list --></div>
<!-- /wp:group -->

<!-- wp:group -->
<div class="wp-block-group"><!-- wp:group {"className":"tm-section-head"} -->
<div class="wp-block-group tm-section-head"><!-- wp:paragraph {"className":"tm-eyebrow"} -->
<p class="tm-eyebrow">FAQ</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Questions</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading --></div>
<!-- /wp:group -->

<!-- wp:group {"className":"tm-faqs"} -->
<div class="wp-block-group tm-faqs"><!-- wp:details {"className":"tm-faq"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details tm-faq"><summary>How long will it take?</summary><!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Single one-sheets arrive within 5 days of your order. Retainer sheets arrive within 3 days.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></details>
<!-- /wp:details -->

<!-- wp:details {"className":"tm-faq"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details tm-faq"><summary>What kind of jokes will it be?</summary><!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Each one-sheet has 10 one- or two-liner jokes, the kind you might hear in a late-night show monologue, plus 5 introductions, transitions, or ad throws customized for your show. It works the same way for podcast episodes and YouTube videos.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></details>
<!-- /wp:details -->

<!-- wp:details {"className":"tm-faq"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details tm-faq"><summary>Would you be willing to write jokes about topics other than TV shows and movies?</summary><!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Yes, absolutely. You can include the subject you’d like jokes about when placing your order.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></details>
<!-- /wp:details -->

<!-- wp:details {"className":"tm-faq"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details tm-faq"><summary>What about refunds?</summary><!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Your first one-sheet is a risk-free trial: if you don’t use any of the jokes in your episode or video, you get your money back. After your first order, one-sheets aren’t refundable. Retainers can be canceled anytime, but payments already made aren’t refunded.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></details>
<!-- /wp:details -->

<!-- wp:details {"className":"tm-faq"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details tm-faq"><summary>Do I need to credit you?</summary><!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>You will own and retain all rights to the jokes. You are not required to credit me as a writer, but if you would like to do so it is highly appreciated.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph --></details>
<!-- /wp:details --></div>
<!-- /wp:group --></div>
<!-- /wp:group -->
